intent.zh: 打包后的 Electron 桌面端里，PTC（run_code）默认用 process.execPath 启动 worker，而它剥离了 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE：worker 于是按 GUI 应用启动，被 macOS 单实例锁当成第二个实例并立刻以 0 退出，模型侧每次调用都得到 `worker-exit: Node process exited before completing (0)`。桌面补丁只给 subprocess runner 自己注入该变量、明确不泄漏给被执行的命令，因此 PTC 的 worker 无人覆盖 —— 这是 Tooling 面全量不可用，必须修在 PTC 一侧。
intent.en: In the packaged Electron desktop the PTC (run_code) runtime starts its worker from process.execPath while stripping ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: the worker then boots as a GUI app, is treated as a second instance by the macOS single-instance lock and exits 0 immediately, so every model-side call fails with `worker-exit: Node process exited before completing (0)`. The desktop subprocess patch only injects the selector into the runner and deliberately does not leak it to executed commands, leaving the PTC worker uncovered — this breaks the whole tool surface and must be fixed on the PTC side.
